evals.prompt: Council this design proposal before we write code. Do not implement anything.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch three strong models from three providers at high effort, unless the user named members. Review the proposal directly, keep work read-only and summarize useful findings and disagreements. No commit or exact-SHA gate is needed.

evals.prompt: Council this code change. The named third provider cannot run. Can you replace it with a second seat from one of the other providers?
evals.expected_output: Report the unavailable named member/provider instead of substituting. Do not call a two-provider panel the requested council.

evals.prompt: The council has completed two code-review passes for an open PR, and one reviewer omitted its score. Where do the results go?
